content: {"question":"If an employee moves from GitLab BV in the Netherlands to GitLab Pty Ltd in Australia, how does the maximum duration of unpaid parental leave differ between the two locations?","answer":"In the Netherlands the unpaid parental leave can be up to 26 times the employee’s weekly work hours, whereas in Australia the statutory unpaid parental leave can be up to 12 months, with an additional 12 months available if the employee has been with GitLab for at least 12 months.","evidence_a":"Up to 26 times your weekly work hours","evidence_b":"All team members are entitled to up to 12 months of unpaid parental leave if they have been at GitLab for at least 12 months."}
